episodes.title: Locker 14
episodes.summary: 1:12 AM, courier Eli Brooks (24, owes $1,800 rent, final notice) gets a call meant for another courier: take what's in locker 14 at Grand Street Station (code 7319) to the blue door on Pier Nine before 2 AM for $5,000, don't open it, don't call back. Locker holds a small heavy metal case with a yellow FRAGILE sticker; it hums. A man in a long grey coat watches; a text says 'Don't trust the man in grey.' Eli flees by bike to Pier Nine, 1:54 AM; the case is now also ticking.
episodes.vote: OPEN (open the case) vs DELIVER (knock on the blue door)

episodes.title: Door Number Nine
episodes.summary: 1:55 AM on Pier Nine, Eli opens the case: a stopped gold pocket watch (hands at 2:00, still ticking), a brass key tagged 9, and a photo of Eli in the Fifth Street diner taken BEFORE the call - it was never the wrong number. The man in grey finally speaks: 'Don't knock on that door, son' - he made the same delivery 22 years ago and 'never came home'. The blue door opens: a woman in a red coat and black gloves knows Eli's name, says his rent is already paid, wants the case AND the key. Man in grey: 'she's paying for what the key opens'; she says he's been lying 22 years. Text from the unknown number: 'Don't give her the key. It opens the door to your father.' Eli's father vanished 22 years ago near the river when Eli was 2 - Eli suspects the man in grey is his father. Ends at 2:00 with her gloved hand out.
episodes.question: Give her the key or keep it (door number nine)?

episodes.title: Under the Pier
episodes.summary: At exactly 2:00 the stopped gold watch starts ticking again. Eli refuses to give up the key; the woman in red: 'Your father said no too.' The lamp goes out, the man in grey says 'Run'; they hide in an old boathouse from a passing car. He is Walter: 22 years ago he and Eli's father carried the same case to the blue door - the father went in, Walter stayed on the pier ('I was a coward'). The watch back is engraved 'To Daniel. Come home before two.' (Daniel Brooks = Eli's father). Stone steps under the pier lead to a brick tunnel of numbered iron doors; at black iron door 9 someone knocks three times from the other side. Text from the unknown number: 'Don't open it yet. She's right behind you.' Something red moves at the end of the tunnel; watch reads 2:04.
episodes.question: Open door nine now, or turn around and face the woman in red?

characters.Eli Brooks: 24, courier, beanie, grey hoodie, yellow delivery bag
characters.Man in grey: Walter: grey hair, long scar on cheek, long grey coat, hat; 22 years ago carried the same case with Eli's father Daniel, stayed on the pier
characters.The caller: quiet fast male voice, unknown number
characters.Woman in red: red coat, black gloves, black hair, calm smile; waits behind the blue door; paid Eli's rent
characters.Daniel Brooks: Eli's father, vanished 22 years ago after going through the blue door; watch engraved 'To Daniel. Come home before two.'

episodes.topic: Building the Great Pyramid of Giza, c. 2560 BC
episodes.title: I Was There When They Built the Great Pyramid
episodes.summary: Ava, 19, bakes bread for pyramid workers in the workers' town; paid workers not slaves, gang 'Friends of Khufu'; rides Merer's boat with Tura limestone (Diary of Merer, Wadi al-Jarf); wet-sand sledges, ramps, Aswan granite, doctors, workers' tombs, Hemiunu, 146 m, tallest for ~3,800 years.

episodes.title: I Was in Pompeii When Vesuvius Erupted
episodes.summary: Ava, 19, sells bread near the bakery of Modestus; street life, stepping stones, wall graffiti/election notices; 62 AD earthquake; midday eruption, Pliny the Younger's 'pine tree' cloud; pumice all night; Pliny the Elder sails toward the volcano after Rectina's plea and dies; pyroclastic surge at dawn; buried 1,600+ years; 81 carbonised loaves; Fiorelli's plaster casts (1860s); 1,000+ victims found; 2018 charcoal inscription suggests October 24.
